newsitem.title: CHINA: China urges peaceful solution in Afghanistan.
newsitem.headline: China urges peaceful solution in Afghanistan.

text.p: China voiced concern on Saturday about the fighting in neighbouring Afghanistan and said it hoped for peace and reconciliation in the wartorn nation.
However, Beijing stopped short of recognising the Taleban militia who took the Afghan capital, Kabul, on Friday.
"China and Afghanistan are close neighbours," the Foreign Ministry said in a statement. "China expresses its concern about the situation of fighting in Afghanistan.

"(China) hopes all sides in the Afghan fighting will place the interests of the state and the people above everything and stop their armed conflict and realise national reconciliation through peaceful negotiation," it said.
China did not respond directly to an appeal from the Taleban for international recognition of its government after its forces captured Kabul.

Two years after their formation, the one-time band of Islamic student vigilantes took over a ruined capital, hanged former president Najibullah and his brother and proclaimed the complete enforcement of Islam in the war-wracked country.
